subject: The 2AM mistake that changed everything
preview_text: I almost deleted SoulPlan at 2AM. Then one feature saved it all.
body_paragraphs: I don't usually write emails like this. But it's 2AM, and I'm sitting here staring at the code that almost killed SoulPlan. Three months ago, I was ready to pull the plug because couples kept opening the app and closing it — they said planning dates felt like a chore. I built this for magic, not another to-do.

Then I watched one couple do something different. They didn't browse the full list. They tapped one mood — cozy, because she had a long day — and the AI picked a single card: 'Build a blanket fort and order takeout.' They did it that night. Next morning, she sent me a screenshot of their Memory Timeline with a photo of the fort and the note: 'We laughed for the first time in weeks.' That's when I knew the spark isn't in more options. It's in one right choice.

That's why Tonight's Date exists. Open your app right now — it's the first thing you see. Tap your mood (cozy, adventurous, playful, healing) and in 30 seconds, you and your partner have a plan. No scrolling. No arguing. Just a moment that says 'I see you.' Our data shows couples who use it in their first 24 hours plan 4x more dates over the next month. That's not a feature. That's a lifeline.

Open SoulPlan: Plan Dates Together now and tap Tonight's Date. Pick any mood. Then send your partner the proposal — watch them get that full-screen 'thought of you tonight' moment. I promise it'll feel different. P.S. — The Memory Timeline saves every date you plan. One day, you'll look back and smile at the night that started with a single tap.
